entries.title: Endzone: A World Apart
entries.definitive_edition: Endzone: A World Apart Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the original platform, has the Complete Edition route with all DLC, and gives the best capture/settings path. Console Survivor/Complete routes are valid but do not add exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release through Steam or GOG, ideally with the Complete Edition or equivalent base-game-plus-DLC purchase. Use PlayStation or Xbox only if a console route is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Original native Windows PC release; Complete Edition route can include all DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: original release route, all-DLC complete option, and best capture/settings path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 console release with Survivor and Complete Edition storefront routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S console release with Survivor/Complete Edition routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route with Smart Delivery support, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox One console release available through Xbox Survivor/Complete Edition store routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route with no sourced exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS4 console release via the PlayStation Store Survivor Edition route.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route with no sourced exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC Complete Edition route resolves the completeness side while still preserving the best capture/settings path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Survivor Edition console releases include console-specific packaging and bundled DLC routes, but they are not separate game entries or remasters.

entries.title: Endzone 2

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release through Steam and GOG is the only sourced public release route found for Endzone 2, so it is both the highest-fidelity and most-complete playable version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam or GOG.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced public playable release route found.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; the single playable route is Windows PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or console port exists for the current release.
